_comment: Storage backend selection. 'sqlite' (default) = single-file local storage. 'mysql' (or 'mariadb') = shared database for multi-server networks with unified balances (Solidus 2.2.0+). The mysql.password value may be overridden with the SOLIDUS_DB_PASSWORD environment variable (recommended).

redis._redis_comment: OPTIONAL coordination layer (2.2.1): L2 balance cache + pub/sub invalidation + instant network-wide notifications. Never the source of truth - the shared database stays authoritative, and a Redis outage degrades to plain database reads. The redis password may be overridden with the SOLIDUS_REDIS_PASSWORD environment variable (passwordEnv names that variable).
